tools.name: access_hosted_inbox
tools.title: Access hosted inbox
tools.description: Hosted only: issue a private inbox token for an inbox you own. Keep the returned token private.

tools.name: check_for_callbacks
tools.title: Check for new callbacks
tools.description: Check for callbacks newer than a sequence cursor without waiting.

tools.name: configure_webhook
tools.title: Configure webhook inbox
tools.description: Set HTTP responses and optional SHA256 HMAC verification, preserving unspecified fields.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.title: Create webhook inbox
tools.description: Create an inbox. Save its private token; share only public capture addresses. A hosted Pro account_key creates a persistent owned inbox.

tools.name: delete_all_requests
tools.title: Delete all captured events
tools.description: Clear stored events, keeping the inbox's addresses and settings.

tools.name: delete_request
tools.title: Delete captured event
tools.description: Permanently delete one event belonging to this inbox.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete webhook inbox
tools.description: Permanently delete this inbox and its stored events.

tools.name: download_request_file
tools.title: Download captured content
tools.description: Retrieve exact captured bytes as base64, including binary bodies or raw MIME.

tools.name: export_webhook_data
tools.title: Export captured events
tools.description: Export a bounded page of full events; resume with next_since. Browser export streams the entire inbox.

tools.name: extract_links_from_request
tools.title: Extract captured links
tools.description: Extract HTTP links and verification codes without visiting the URLs.

tools.name: generate_oob_payloads
tools.title: Get out-of-band callback addresses
tools.description: Read callback addresses for authorized out-of-band testing.

tools.name: get_hosted_inboxes
tools.title: List hosted inboxes
tools.description: Hosted only: list your persistent inboxes and usage using a private account agent key.

tools.name: get_request
tools.title: Read captured event
tools.description: Read a complete event; omit request_id to inspect the newest one.

tools.name: get_webhook_activity
tools.title: Read inbox activity
tools.description: Read durable receipt and mutation history with a cursor. Bodies and secrets are excluded.

tools.name: get_webhook_email
tools.title: Get inbox email address
tools.description: Read the email address, available when this deployment runs SMTP.

tools.name: get_webhook_info
tools.title: Inspect webhook inbox
tools.description: Read addresses, expiry, response settings, and retained event count.

tools.name: get_webhook_requests
tools.title: List captured events
tools.description: Read events with pagination or a durable sequence cursor.

tools.name: register_github_webhook
tools.title: Register GitHub webhook
tools.description: Create a signed GitHub repository subscription and native inbox. Requires webhook-write permission.

tools.name: register_linear_webhook
tools.title: Register Linear webhook
tools.description: Create a signed Linear subscription and native inbox. Requires admin scope; optional team filter.

tools.name: register_stripe_webhook
tools.title: Register Stripe webhook
tools.description: Create a signed Stripe webhook endpoint and native inbox. Provider credentials are not stored.

tools.name: respond_to_next_request
tools.title: Configure next callback response
tools.description: Respond to the next request using ?openhook_wait=1, within its 20-second response window.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_token
tools.title: Rotate inbox token
tools.description: Revoke the old private token and return a new one; capture addresses stay unchanged.

tools.name: search_requests
tools.title: Search captured events
tools.description: Search captured bodies, URLs, and headers for a literal substring.

tools.name: send_requests
tools.title: Create test events
tools.description: Create up to ten marked test HTTP events in this inbox.

tools.name: server_status
tools.title: Inspect server status
tools.description: Inspect native storage, retention, and enabled capture transports.

tools.name: unregister_webhook
tools.title: Unregister provider webhook
tools.description: Remove the registered provider subscription and permanently delete its native inbox and events.

tools.name: update_request
tools.title: Annotate captured event
tools.description: Annotate an event without changing its original captured body.

tools.name: wait_for_email
tools.title: Wait for email
tools.description: Wait for an email received by Openhook's SMTP listener.

tools.name: wait_for_request
tools.title: Wait for a callback
tools.description: Wait up to 120 seconds; pass next_since when reconnecting to avoid missing events.
